data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2017 Syndicate 33 reported opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,513.556m. The technical provisions note shows a gross prior-year over-provision of GBP 264.369m (a release), driven predominantly by favourable claims development and releases on older lines (including professional indemnity and other prior years). The release reduced prior year liabilities materially (17.5% of opening gross claims). The 2017 catastrophe activity (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria) materially affected the 2017 year of account but prior-year reserves experienced net favourable development.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary source for prior-year movement is the Technical Provisions note (claims incurred table) which shows a gross 'Over-provision in respect of prior claims' of (264,369) (GBP 000). All reserve and triangle figures are taken from notes presented in GBP 000 and have been converted to millions where required. The underwriting accounts mention a GBP 119.4m release from 2014 & prior (underwriting-year disclosure) which is reported in the syndicate underwriting year accounts; both figures are reported here. No explicit gross PYD breakdown by LOB is provided, so LOB movements are directional and unquantified. Claims development triangle is present (gross) and used as corroborating data.
